weakness.title: Excessive Physical Access Rights
weakness.description: A person holds physical access rights to areas that their role does not require.

extended_description.applicability: Any facility that assigns access rights to persons or groups through badges, keys or codes, such as a general-purpose badge that also opens the server room. The weakness lies in the scope of the rights, not in the credential technology. Rights that match the role are not affected.
extended_description.exploitation: A person who holds the rights, or anyone who obtains their credential, can enter areas that the role does not require.

row.details: Persons can view or remove information, media and equipment outside their duties.
Equipment can be altered by persons with no need to handle it.
The loss or misuse of one credential exposes every area it opens.

row.description: Map each area to the roles that need it, and grant rights from that mapping.
Require a specific authorization for sensitive areas instead of including them in general-purpose access profiles.
Review who holds access to each sensitive area, and remove rights that are no longer needed.

row.measure: Withdraw rights on change of role
row.description: Remove rights when a person changes role or leaves.
Narrowing access rights must not prevent anyone from leaving an area.
Maintenance and on-call staff still need timely access. Provide it through a defined procedure rather than broad standing rights.
Responders must retain access through a documented procedure.

row.reference: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PE-2 Physical Access Authorizations, AC-6 Least Privilege
